<Subject 1> = the older woman of <Picture 1>
<Subject 2> = a gaunt second person, curled tight like a folded umbrella

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera, framed from the waist up, and at first appears completely normal. The camera pushes in at slow speed. A localized pressure begins beneath the skin as <Subject 2> starts moving inside <Subject 1>, travelling from the thigh up through the hip and across the belly. Throughout the movement <Subject 1> keeps perfectly smooth skin, the shape beneath visible only in the way the light falls across it, and <Subject 2> is perceived only as a three-dimensional shape pressing outward from within. The movement stays patient, advancing a little with every breath the host takes, and the areas it has already passed slowly return to their original form. In the final phase <Subject 2> reaches the end of its path and presses its face outward until the stretched skin shows its features in sharp relief, staring into the camera.

overall_soundscape: Restrained breathing, subtle internal shifting, and soft surface tension following the moving shape.
